items.title: Communities Across Michigan Expand Data Center Moratoriums Covering Over 1,500 Square Miles
items.dek: Local governments continue pausing new proposals as opposition grows over energy demands, water use and community impacts; MLive analysis highlights the scale equivalent to Rhode Island.
items.judge_note: MLive analysis aggregating the cumulative scale of Michigan moratoriums is incremental/contextual rather than reporting a new decision, but the 1,500-square-mil

items.title: Capitol watch: SB1047 — Senate Co-sponsor(s) Named: Jeremy Moss
items.dek: Public utilities: rates; separate rate class for large-load customers; require. Amends 1939 PA 3 (MCL 460.1 - 460.11) by adding sec. 10ii. Recorded action in the Michigan Legislature; see the full bill history at the source link.
items.judge_note: Concrete legislative development: Jeremy Moss added as co-sponsor to utility rate bill targeting data centers, a new action on a relevant bill.
